system.description:
Consolidates the Assassin, Infiltrator, and Vanguard prestige classes. Grants access to the Assassin, Awareness, Bothan SpyNet, Camouflage, GenoHaradan, Infiltration, Malkite Poisoner, Spy, and Vanguard talent trees.

At 1st level, chooses one of Lead Infiltrator, Surprise Attack, Mark, or Unarmed Stun as a free class ability. The others may be taken as talents.
